about.title: Where performance meets hospitality
body: Elite Performance Club was founded on a simple idea borrowed from the hospitality world: training should feel considered from the moment you arrive. Private suites, a concierge team, and coaches selected for both expertise and discretion.
We work with a deliberately small membership so that every session, every program, and every detail can be handled the way a five-star property handles its guests.

blogPosts.title: The Discipline of Doing Less, Better
blogPosts.excerpt: On why the most effective body composition plans are often the most restrained.
blogPosts.author: Julian Ferreira
content: The clients who see the most refined results rarely follow the most aggressive plans — they follow the most consistent ones.
A measured caloric deficit, adequate protein, and two to three well-coached strength sessions a week will outperform an extreme regimen followed for three weeks and abandoned.
We review progress in trends over weeks, not days, and we adjust deliberately rather than reactively.
The goal is never a dramatic before-and-after. It's a plan refined enough to become simply how you live.

sections.heading: Information we collect
sections.body: We collect the information provided during your membership application and consultations — contact details, health information relevant to programming, and billing details.

sections.heading: How we use it
sections.body: Your information is used solely to deliver your membership services and is handled with the same discretion we apply to all client relationships. We do not sell member data to third parties.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You may request a copy of your data, or its deletion, at any time through your concierge.

sections.heading: Membership terms
sections.body: Membership is by application and billed monthly. Cancellation requires 30 days written notice to your concierge.

sections.heading: Facility use
sections.body: Private suites must be reserved in advance through your concierge. Guest access is available by prior arrangement.

sections.heading: Liability
sections.body: Exercise carries inherent risk. Members are responsible for training within their own limits and disclosing relevant health information to their coach.
